sourceAnchors.message: To be compliant to J2EE, a webapp should not use any thread.
sourceAnchors.reason: Batch checks interrupt before and after owned JDBC operations; the code observes the caller flag and creates no thread.

sourceAnchors.message: Avoid catching RuntimeException in try-catch block
sourceAnchors.reason: At each owned row/statement boundary the typed catch remembers the primary and rethrows the same object, or delegates cleanup precedence. SS332 requires exact unchecked identity, exactly-once closure and a fixed public SQL catalogue.
